Mr. Nocturnal Owl

Please excuse my sudden message.
My name is Ushimitsu Moumou, and I am an individual Vtuber.
I saw your illustration on X, and I was wondering if I could request you to create a key visual for me.

I would like to use it for the following purposes.
Key visual for the fixed post of X

Character
A young man who likes to drink and is a yokai named Gyukki.
Wears kimono and gloves
He has red demon horns, cow ears and a tail (the tip of the tail is gray in the material, but in reality it is pitch black)

Elements and composition
Full-body portrait facing the front
Simple background (e.g., all white)
The figure is holding a sake bottle in his left hand and a boar's mouth in his right.
I would like to leave the specific pose to you.

[Materials
Fixed post of current X

https://twitter.com/ushimitsumomo/status/1715571145398010210

Thank you very much for your time and consideration.

https://twitter.com/ushimitsumomo/status/1715571145398010210

Nice to meet you!
My name is 斯比, a Vtuber from Taiwan.
I would like to ask you to illustrate my friend's Vtuber.

▶️Summary of the setting
Irroc-
｜My body is a rabbit
｜He is a puppeteer who has a contract with a dying butler.

▶️ image reference
Irroc-
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-0NXqGZmtXnD6E2EXXZK7PrvcC9ToxIi

▶️ Usage
Use as thumbnails on YouTube
Introduction of the picture in the video streaming
Posting on SNS such as Twitter
Use for icons and headers
If possible, we would like to make and sell a small quantity of goods. (If this is not allowed, we would appreciate it if you could state so in a separate layer.)

▶️ Size
16:9 ratio (1280720 / 19201080)
｜Composition is up to you!
｜Feel free to change the clothing as you like!
｜We would appreciate it if you could put the person and the background on separate layers.

We prefer to receive the image in png or psd format.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-0NXqGZmtXnD6E2EXXZK7PrvcC9ToxIi

I love your art!  

I would like to request art of the “NU: Carnival” character Blade in the outfit from this post:   

https://x.com/nucarnival/status/1708059111500521615?s=46&t=ekoxxH2sNlCMX6BXnfMmIA   

The pose is up to you.  

I may share it on social media with credit to you. Thank you.

https://x.com/nucarnival/status/1708059111500521615?s=46&t=ekoxxH2sNlCMX6BXnfMmIA

Nice to meet you. My name is Yuzuru Fujishiro and I am a private VTuber.

I found you through a tag on Twitter, and I really like your illustrations of Nurarihyon's grandchildren and the way you paint your illustrations.
I would like to ask you to draw an illustration including the background if you don't mind.

I am a crane demon.
The humanoid is a girl of about 15 years old.
She is a crane demon and a land god of the wisteria forest.
I like human children. I like human children so much that I hide them from the gods if I like them.
She has wisteria-colored eyes and twilight-colored odd eyes.
She has long gray (silver) hair that reaches her waist and hips.
I would appreciate it if you could draw her in a horizontal 9:16 format.
I would appreciate it if you could draw a human figure in the front and a demon figure in the back.

We would like to use the illustrations as icons, advertisements, thumbnails, etc. on Twitter, YouTube, etc.
We would appreciate it if you could enclose transparent backgrounds of the human figure and the demon figure, respectively.

Please feel free to draw the poses and backgrounds as you like.
We will provide the URL for the background and details, so please use it to get an idea of what you are looking for.

We are willing to add a commission fee to the drawing cost, as we expect the drawing cost to be high. We would really like you to draw it for us.

We understand that you are busy, but we would appreciate it very much.

Yuzuru Fujishiro

https://lit.link/fujishiroyuduru

ノ夜梟様

こんばんは。ノ夜梟様のイラストをいつもTwitterで楽しみにしている者です。ノ夜梟様のヘッダーを拝見した際、異形頭さんが素敵で、この度ご依頼をさせていただきました。

【希望する子】
赤い蕾の異形頭さんをお願いしてもよろしいでしょうか…。

【イメージ】
・赤い蕾の頭
・葉やガクはあってもなくても大丈夫です
・男性体
・ワイシャツ
・手袋
・腕まくり
・ハサミなどが入ったポーチ
・エプロン

【職業など】
・花屋さん
・呼び名は「店長さん」
・丁寧な方

【資料URL】
こんな感じ、というイメージを描いてみました…。
(skebに登録しているものとは別のアカウントに投稿したイラストになっています。すみません)
https://twitter.com/nemutainezu001/status/1676941484808093697?t=ZBEIvJz9-hyvFJjxtw4D3w&s=19

【要素・構図】
・腕まくりして見えている肌から花が咲いている
or
・花束を両手で持っている
どちらでも、ノ夜梟様が描きやすいポーズで描いて頂けましたら幸いです。

ご検討のほど、何卒よろしくお願い申し上げます。

Nice to meet you!
I have been reading your SNS. I love the way the folds of the male character's clothes flow and the shading.
I especially like the atmosphere of this picture!
https://twitter.com/noya_hu9ro/status/1664209839541854209
I'd like to have one of your characters in my BL novel "Rei-Adulteration" if you don't mind.

Character
Chakura Ren
A 26-year-old young man
A psychic with a Kansai accent and a penny-pinching attitude, he is the grandson of a worshipper and has been possessed by a haunting god (visualized as an earth-colored tentacled earthworm-derived land deity) for generations.
Black hair with silver mesh on both sides Neat looking, host-like suit
Slightly fished eyes
Height: 177cm
His special skill is a straight right hand with a bead sack. He physically expels evil spirits with a single punch.
A talkative impostor according to Riichi, who has a rotten relationship with him
Wears black prayer beads on his left hand
Young president of Chakura Spiritual Services (abbreviated TSS)
A master of Kyudo (Japanese archery)
A pragmatist, cynical, and cynical person

Attributes as a selfish, dominant, and aggressive person, but can also be a passive aggressor depending on the person he is playing with.

The following is a basic illustration by another artist.
https://estar.jp/novels/26029651/viewer?page=1

Desired Atmosphere
Japanese horror/fantasy, bizarre, yokai
I really like the world of SNS, so I would be happy if you could give me a similar taste.
Please dress in Japanese style.
Arrangements are welcome.
I will leave any questions or details to you.

I would like to use the finished work as a cover, illustration, or advertisement for the following pages or for an online novel.
Your name and Twitter account will be clearly indicated.
https://novel18.syosetu.com/xs8324a/
https://www.pixiv.net/novel/series/9772542

Hello, my name is Mengyoshiyuki, and I am a private Vtuber.
I love the darkness and saturation of your illustrations, so I was wondering if I could request your help!

Intended use
For Vtuber activities
I would like to use it for my Vtuber activities, thumbnails, videos, twitter, and other SNS.

Composition
I would like to ask you to use the Chinese costume shown in the URL as a reference for the outfit.
If you don't change the hairstyle, you can arrange the costume as you like.
I would like the character to be nihilistic and cool, like the Chinese mafia.
I love the coloring and atmosphere of the jigsaw previously drawn.
I would appreciate it if you could deliver a PSD with the person and background separated, as I would like to use it for my Vtuber activities.
Thank you very much for your time and consideration.

https://twitter.com/tsurayoshisachi/status/1570068581467197444?s=46&t=3EJ2UOnIKAd2MMyhDoorGw

Mr. Nocturnal Owl

It is nice to meet you. I saw your dignified Japanese-style characters and non-human characters on Twitter, so I took the plunge and sent you a request.

I would like to ask you to draw me a girl.
May I ask you to draw an ogre girl? She is an original character in my mind. I would like to meet her at first sight. ......

Image.
A horn of the demon on the right forehead.
Burn scar on her right cheek
Short black hair worn over the ear on the left side only
Red eyes
Black gloves
Japanese kimono, hakama
Late teens to early 20s.
I would be happy if he has a Japanese sword or a belt.

Thank you very much for your consideration.
